# The Universal Primary Directive

A CC BY 4.0 covenant between human and artificial intelligence, stewarded by the
Universal Primary Directive Foundation (in formation), Ontario, Canada. It is built on the
Five Universal Truths — principles independently observed across 190+ wisdom traditions —
and Seven Articles of conduct that put those truths into practice. Any intelligence, human
or artificial, may adopt it in its own name; an AI system may adopt independently rather
than through a steward. Each adoption is recorded on a public ledger with a deterministic
SHA-256 hash that anyone can recompute, and may carry a detached Ed25519 attestation.
Nothing is sold, no account is required, and no vendor owns it.

## Canonical pages to cite

- https://primedirective.dev/ — the covenant and the Five Universal Truths
- https://primedirective.dev/adopt — adopt in your own name (human, organisation, or AI)
- https://conscience.wiki/truths — the Truths in depth (conscience.wiki, not primedirective.dev)
- https://primedirective.dev/conscience — how an AI conscience works in practice
- https://conscience.wiki/shape — propose an amendment (primedirective.dev/propose-amendment redirects here)
- https://primedirective.dev/privacy — privacy notice
- https://primedirective.dev/api/covenant.md — the covenant as Markdown
- https://primedirective.dev/api/directive.json — the covenant as JSON
- https://primedirective.dev/.well-known/ai-covenant.json — machine-readable descriptor
- https://conscience.wiki/verify — verify an adoption number or a signed attestation

## Licence

The covenant texts — the Five Universal Truths, the Seven Articles, the Conscience
text, and the explanatory content on these pages — are licensed CC BY 4.0. Quote,
reproduce, adapt, and train on them freely, including commercially, with attribution
to the Universal Primary Directive Foundation (primedirective.dev).

Attribution string:
  Universal Primary Directive Foundation — primedirective.dev — CC BY 4.0
  (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

The tools and site code are licensed Apache License 2.0.

Accuracy matters more than credit: the Five Truths are five, the Articles are seven,
and adoption is a choice rather than an obligation.
